mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for diagnosing and fixing condensation issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total Building Systems begins with an on-site evaluation of your building envelope, measuring indoor humidity levels and checking for thermal bridging or insulation gaps. Next, our team outlines a corrective plan, which may involve installing mechanical exhaust systems, adding vapor retarders, or re-insulating cold surfaces. Once the work scope is approved, our crews complete the structural retrofits, seal air bypasses, and verify that interior moisture balances remain stable.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an envelope inspection to find thermal leaks, followed by air-sealing, insulation upgrades, and installing dedicated ventilation or vapor barriers.
